subject: Copywriting
subcategory: The Science of Storytelling in Ads
title: The Three-Act Structure
description: Learn The Three-Act Structure in one minute.

hook.text: Every Hollywood movie follows three acts: setup, confrontation, resolution. So does every great 30-second commercial.

buildup.text: Act 1 sets the world. Act 2 introduces conflict. Act 3 resolves it. Aristotle defined this 2,300 years ago.

discovery.text: Nike's 'Find Your Greatness' follows it exactly: ordinary people (setup), facing limits (conflict), pushing through.

twist.text: The three-act structure works in six-second ads too. Vine stars mastered setup-punchline in seconds.

climax.text: Whether it's a 60-second Super Bowl ad or a Facebook post, three acts give the audience a complete experience.

punchline.text: Setup, conflict, resolution. 2,300 years and it still works.

quiz.question: Who originally defined the three-act structure?
